title: The Hero of Ages
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: The last book of the original Mistborn trilogy. The world is clearly failing, and a small band races to understand what is coming and whether anything can stop it.
readIf: you want a big payoff with lots of revelations that reward close attention to the magic.
skipIf: you have not read the earlier books, as every plot thread here depends on them.

pairings.reason: Another world facing a slow apocalypse with magic that is deeply tied to it, more raw and unsettling.
The opening of another long fantasy saga about a world-saving struggle, with a similar sense of approaching darkness.
A short, lyrical fantasy for a reader who wants a breather after a very large series.
